hard_stops: grade or task outside declared scope
manual_review_reasons: all scores until teacher pilot and independent validation completed
rater total gap >=4/20 or any dimension gap >=2/5
rater differs on ratability or relevance
unstable prediction or large model disagreement
future calibrated interval too wide under predeclared utility threshold
label_rule: no model scores visible during independent human rating; never overwrite raw ratings

conformal_plan.calibration_required: separate real human-rated calibration set not used for fitting or model/threshold selection
conformal_plan.quantile_rank: ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)); if rank>n abstain rather than invent finite coverage
conformal_plan.coverage_scope: marginal under exchangeability; no per-essay certainty or guaranteed grade/prompt subgroup coverage
conformal_plan.shift_policy: new prompt, grade or school drift requires review/recalibration; no unconditional claim
